releases.home: The agent looking after the home now has short skills for each job and hears about Miakapp updates, so it can tell you what a new version brings before applying it.
steps: Commit the skills `miakapp update` wrote in .claude/skills/ and .agents/skills/ with the shorter guide and instruction blocks.
From now on, when a command reports a newer Miakapp, follow the `miakapp-update` skill: tell the owner what it brings and ask before updating.

releases.home: Publishing right after a preview works the first time.
steps: Nothing to change. `miakapp publish` activates a build that `preview` or `taps` already registered instead of failing.

releases.home: Checking the app before publishing is faster and more reliable.
steps: Nothing to change. `miakapp preview` reuses an already finalized build; `miakapp taps` waits for start-up answers before tapping.

releases.home: Every button is now tested on the real home, at phone size, before you see it: fewer buttons that do nothing.
steps: Stop testing against a hand-written fake bridge: delete any phone.html / frame.html test harness.
Check the app with `miakapp preview --as <role>` then `miakapp taps --as <role>` for each role, and fix what taps reports.
Give `test:<role>` that role's rights in the coordinator's member list (never owner), so test links see what that role sees.

releases.home: Visitors can ask to join the home or use an invitation from its page.
steps: An app may now call `miakapp.join`: declare it under `app.requires.call` if the app offers 'ask to join' or 'redeem an invitation'.
Read `miakapp docs members` again for the join flow.

releases.home: Invitation links can be shared straight from the app (share sheet or copy).
steps: Refresh the bridge app/miakapp.ts (`miakapp update` does it) to get `home.share()` and `home.copy()`.
Coordinator: bump `miakapi` to 4.6.0 or later to declare `miakapp.join`, the visitors' door, and restart it.

releases.home: Guests can be given access to the rest of the house only while they are on its Wi-Fi.
steps: Coordinator: `miakapi` 4.4.0+ adds `call.source.transport` (direct or relay) and `stateAccess[].directPatterns`; 4.5.0+ adds `address`, the phone's home-network address on direct calls; 4.5.1+ passes the coordinator's error sentence to the app. Bump and restart if the home uses them.

releases.home: The home can have members with roles, join requests and invitations, decided by the home itself.
steps: Read `miakapp docs members` and build the member list in the coordinator before the home is shared.
Refresh the bridge app/miakapp.ts to get `home.link` (an invitation code carried by the home's link).

releases.home: Bar buttons can show a count, for example join requests waiting.
steps: Refresh the bridge app/miakapp.ts to pass `badge` in `home.bar.setButtons()` and use the `people` and `bell` icons.

releases.home: Notifications reach only the people the home chooses, never everyone who opened it.
steps: `miakapp notify` now requires `--to <user-id>[,…]`: update every script or coordinator that calls it without recipients.

releases.home: The home's link has its new address.
steps: Older CLIs refuse to publish: pin 4.3.1 or later.
